title: Pan-Seared Ukrainian Dumplings with Fennel
description: A hearty and flavorful Ukrainian-inspired dish featuring pan-seared dumplings served with a crunchy fennel slaw.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the dumplings and cook until golden brown on the bottom, about 2-3 minutes.
Flip the dumplings and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until golden brown.
While the dumplings are cooking, combine the sliced fennel and Ukrainian seasoning mix in a bowl.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Once the dumplings are cooked, transfer them to a plate and top with the fennel slaw.
Garnish with chopped chives or parsley, if desired.
